tasks_completed.description: Rewrote CodexBashView to unify read/write/bash branches through ScrollView horizontal + CommandView primitives
tasks_completed.changes: All three operation branches now use ScrollView horizontal as outer container, matching BashView.tsx:62 inline pattern and SidebarBashView.tsx:44-46 sidebar pattern. Removed divergent readContainer stylesheet (surfaceHigh bg, borderRadius:8, padding:12). Added parseCodexBashResult helper reusing knownTools.Bash.result schema, so completed bash tool calls now render real stdout/stderr/error (was hardcoded to null). Added MAX_PREVIEW_LINES=2 + countLines/truncateLines + '+N more lines' indicator for inline-preview parity with BashView.tsx.
tasks_completed.rationale: Per BA spec Must-Have R1-R5: read/write branches had zero horizontal-scroll protection; bash branch wrapped CommandView without ScrollView; container styling used surfaceHigh instead of CommandView.terminal.background. Rewrite delegates all three branches to shared primitives so they inherit Claude Code's overflow handling and visual treatment.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: cdbcb9ab — wip: working on codex bash (2025-09-03)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: CodexBashView was created in Sep 2025 before CommandView and the compact-inline pattern existed. Commit 1c85cc62 (Mar 2026) normalized Claude Code bash rendering but did not update CodexBashView, leaving it on a stale visual path.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Rewrite migrates all three Codex branches (read, write, bash) to the same ScrollView horizontal + CommandView shape that BashView / SidebarBashView adopted in 1c85cc62, closing the 7-month visual-parity gap.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Full rewrite authorized by BA spec: development_approach.strategy says 'Rewrite CodexBashView to delegate all three branches to the same structural primitives as BashView/SidebarBashView'. R1-R5 are Must-Have and each requires structural changes to a different branch; together with R4 (thread stdout/stderr/error through CommandView) and the QA-BA pass-with-warnings upgrade of truncateLines/+N more lines to Must-have for parity with BashView, the minimum diff is ~90 lines. The 17-line overage over the minimum is helper definitions (countLines/truncateLines/parseCodexBashResult) that mirror BashView.tsx verbatim rather than importing — an inline clone is justified by BA's instruction to keep the change self-contained without introducing a new shared module.

dev.qa_notes: (1) Render a Codex read tool call with a long file path (e.g. >80 chars) — verify the inline card scrolls horizontally instead of overflowing. (2) Render a Codex write tool call with a long path — same. (3) Render a Codex exec_command with multi-line stdout output (>2 lines) — verify: (a) stdout renders inside CommandView (was previously always null), (b) first 2 lines show, (c) '+N more lines' appears. (4) Compare a Codex exec_command card side-by-side with a Claude Code Bash card — outer chrome should be visually indistinguishable (same bg via terminal.background, same radius, same padding, same font). (5) Open the right-side sidebar for a CodexBash call — SidebarBashView is unchanged, must render correctly (regression check). (6) Verify mobile viewport (390x844) — no layout overflow. (7) Verify zh-Hans locale — readingFile / writingFile labels render correctly. (8) Depends on P4 (§5.3, CommandView flexWrap / flex:1 fix) for full overflow cure; dev cycle for §5.6 delivers the structural wrap, P4 delivers the flexbox fix.

self_verification.smoke_check: skipped (no executable criteria — QA will verify via live browser on dev.life-ai.app)
self_verification.notes: Ran `yarn typecheck`. Zero errors surface for CodexBashView.tsx. Pre-existing errors in 6 unrelated files (SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx, SidebarNavigator.tsx, MarkdownView.tsx, parseMarkdownBlock.ts, SidebarAgentConversation.tsx, SidebarFileView.tsx) belong to other overnight cycles (§5.11, §5.17) running in parallel — not part of §5.6 scope. No guards were removed: the parsedCmd array-guard at old line 31 and the commandStr/stringifyToolCommand fallback chain at old line 88 are both preserved (now at lines 66 and 100 respectively).

recommendations: Once P4 lands CommandView.tsx flexWrap/flex:1 fix, the Codex bash-branch popup inherits the overflow cure automatically — no further changes needed here.
ToolView.tsx:168-174 buildIcon special-case for CodexBash (eye/file-diff/terminal) is for the tool-card *header* row, not the inline body. It is still needed and should not be removed.
§5.13 (Codex subagent tasks not displayed), §5.14 (Codex multi-file edit), §5.15 (full Codex tool coverage) can now adopt the same ScrollView + CommandView primitive pattern established here.

Consider extracting parseBashResult / countLines / truncateLines into a shared util (e.g. packages/happy-app/sources/components/tools/bashResultUtils.ts) if a third consumer appears — currently cloned between BashView and CodexBashView to keep the §5.6 change self-contained.
